name: WinterWolfTypeB
identity: Cream-white and warm pale taupe shaggy wolf, scattered flat round ochre spots on forehead, cheek, flank and tail base; two tall pointed cream ears with dark taupe outer edges and ochre inner pads on FRONT ONLY; large ivory-white eyes with tiny dark pupils, broad cream muzzle with brown ochre nose and small ivory fangs; small brown chin tuft and larger brown throat/chest fur bib; four short cream canine paws, NOT hooves; full long white bushy downward-curving tail with ochre basal spot and taupe underside. No collar, saddle, armor, dorsal spikes, horns, rider, blue recolor or black fur banding.

source_review.findings: White/taupe base and ochre spots; ivory-white eyes rather than generic amber; original brown ventral bib and chin tuft; seven visible non-shadow renderers: head, torso, four legs, tail.
